title: FBI Photo B008
sensor_system_note: B-series — large full-frame crosshair reticle, '12/31/99 HH:MM:SS' factory-reset sensor clock visible bottom-left, scale markings '15 10 5 | 5 10 15' in burst-1 / early burst-2 and '3' after the high-mag zoom at B022. Sky/atmosphere background throughout (no terrain in burst 2). Different sensor system from A-series.

pages.description: A grainy black-and-white image resembling a targeting or surveillance scope display. A white crosshair with a graduated reticle crosses the center, with horizontal scale markings labeled 15, 10, 5, 0, 5, 10, 15 along a central axis. The background is noisy gray. A solid black bar spans the top of the frame. Several black rectangular redaction-like bars are placed symmetrically at left and right sides in three rows (upper, middle, lower), some with lighter gray gradient edges. A small dark speck sits just right of the crosshair center. The bottom portion shows faint darker gradient shapes. A timestamp is burned into the lower-left corner.
